title: Researchers warned of North Korean hacking tactics years before record $6.3B Binance heist | TechCrunch
summary: In its latest statement, Binance said that North Korean hackers, posing as recruiters hiring for a job, contacted a software engineer who works on wallets at the company. Binance said its security tools did not detect the malware.
